purpose: Independent raw-source census of every current Enhancement predicate and participant scope. Never generated from rule contracts.

subjectPolicy.MODEL: Individual enhancement bearer or explicitly selected bodyguard/attacking model. Relative bearerUnit state fields are evaluated on the bearer MODEL context without requiring an attachment.
subjectPolicy.UNIT: A generic own, friendly or enemy unit; includes a lone bearer unit and does not require attachment.
subjectPolicy.FORMED_ATTACHED_UNIT: The led unit only when the source explicitly requires the bearer to be leading.

contextPolicy.STATIC: Identity, intrinsic keyword and unrestricted participant predicates.
contextPolicy.BATTLE: Attack events, battle triggers, current battlefield/reserves state and optional ability activation.
